name: @projexlight/sdk-connectors
summary: Connector framework — the shared scaffolding every connector-* SDK builds on: OAuth flow helpers, refresh-token rotation, webhook signature verification, sync-job scheduling primitives, dead-letter handling. Customers don't install this directly; specific connector SDKs (salesforce/hubspot/slack/etc) compose it.

endpoints.description: Generic install endpoint; routes to the right connector's installer.
OAuth callback handler — exchanges code → refresh token via sdk-secrets.
Inbound webhook receiver; verifies signature + routes to handler.
Sync job status + last run + next scheduled.
Replay a dead-lettered webhook from the DLQ.
List active installs for a tenant.

events.name: connectors.oauth.completed.v1
events.description: OAuth flow completed; refresh token stored in vault.

hooks.name: completeOauth
hooks.description: Exchange OAuth code → refresh token; store via sdk-secrets.

hooks.name: verifyWebhookSignature
hooks.description: Generic HMAC verifier; per-connector signature schemes.

hooks.name: replayDlq
hooks.description: Replay a webhook from the DLQ.

scenarios.title: Generic OAuth callback handler
scenarios.when_to_use: Every connector-* SDK uses completeOauth for its OAuth dance; the framework handles state validation + token storage uniformly.
scenarios.example_code:
import { completeOauth } from '@projexlight/sdk-connectors';
await completeOauth({ connector: 'salesforce', code, state });
scenarios.expected_outcome: State validated. Refresh token vault-wrapped. Emits .oauth.completed.v1.

scenarios.title: Webhook signature verified per connector
scenarios.when_to_use: Inbound webhook arrives; the framework looks up the connector's signature scheme + verifies before dispatching to the handler.

scenarios.title: Per-connector sync scheduling
scenarios.when_to_use: After install, connector calls scheduleSync to register its recurring sync — framework handles the cron + retry + DLQ.
scenarios.example_code:
import { scheduleSync } from '@projexlight/sdk-connectors';
await scheduleSync({ connector: 'salesforce', install_id, cadence_min: 15 });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Sync registered; runs on cadence. Failures retry + eventually DLQ.

scenarios.title: Replay a dead-lettered webhook
scenarios.when_to_use: Operator notices a webhook in the DLQ + replays after fixing the root cause.
scenarios.example_code:
import { replayDlq } from '@projexlight/sdk-connectors';
await replayDlq({ message_id });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message re-dispatched. If fails again, returns to DLQ with the failure count incremented.

compliance_posture.notes: OAuth tokens vault-wrapped. Signature verification mandatory; missing/invalid → 401 + audited. DLQ retention bounded so replays of stale messages eventually expire.
